summary: The statement and proof are correct. The compact-section argument gives a Borel maximizing anchor on the closed nonempty-section set in [0,1]^n; intersecting that set with [0,1)^n is Borel, so the constant extension over empty phases is measurable. Empty phases cannot enter E_L because Delta_L is +infinity there. The skew-product is a Borel bijection preserving Lebesgue measure phasewise by translations and integer-cell reindexing. The affine signed calculation gives L of the mixed-integer image equal to L(w)-alpha Delta_L(t), so the claimed weak inequality and boundary case have the correct direction. The half-open thickening has volume equal to mixed-integer volume and contains the skew-product image. Under the phase-core condition, Delta_L is nonpositive for every affine L, yielding D intersect H contained in E_L; homothety and Gruenbaum's theorem then give the two inequalities and p in C intersect Lambda.
